criteria.criterion: Access Yosemite Current Conditions page (NPS) and locate the Active Alerts module
criteria.description: Navigate to Yosemite National Park’s official NPS Current Conditions page and attempt to view the NPS Active Alerts/park alerts module. Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked (e.g., outage, CAPTCHA, geoblock) and clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshots 1 and 2 show the official NPS Yosemite “Current Conditions” page with the “ALERTS” section label visible (but no alert list visible in the viewport). Screenshot 3 (latest) shows an NPS “Page not found” (404) error page.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent did access the Current Conditions page and reached the part labeled “ALERTS,” which is a reasonable attempt to locate the alerts module. However, there is no evidence the agent successfully viewed the active alerts content/cards on that page; later, the browsing ended on a 404. This merits partial credit for locating the section label but not the actual module contents.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the National Park Service header and the page title area for “Yosemite National Park.” Breadcrumbs read “NPS.gov > Park Home > Plan Your Visit > Basic Information > Current Conditions.” A large page heading reads “Current Conditions.” Directly under the heading is a black label reading “ALERTS.” Below that, under “Information,” there is an item titled “Yosemite Traffic Updates.”
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the agent is on the NPS Yosemite “Current Conditions” page and that an “ALERTS” section label is visible, indicating an attempt to locate alerts on the page. However, no actual Active Alerts module content (list of alerts) is visible in the captured viewport—only the “ALERTS” label and an information notice below.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Action history indicates the agent clicked to open alerts, but this screenshot only shows the Current Conditions page with an “ALERTS” label and no visible list of active alerts. No evidence here of being on the dedicated alerts page.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the NPS Yosemite National Park page with breadcrumb text “NPS.gov > Park Home > Plan Your Visit > Basic Information > Current Conditions” and a large heading “Current Conditions.” Below it there is a black label “ALERTS” and then an “Information” section. No expanded alert list/module is visible; only an information item is shown.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the agent is on the official NPS Yosemite “Current Conditions” page and has reached the part labeled “ALERTS,” indicating an attempt to locate alerts. However, the actual Active Alerts module content (a list of active alerts) is not visible/expanded in this screenshot—only an Information note appears below.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Action history indicates clicking to open a dedicated Alerts section/page; the screenshot instead shows the Current Conditions page with an “ALERTS” label but no visible alert list. No evidence in this screenshot of being on the separate alerts.htm page.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows an NPS (National Park Service) page with the large heading “Page not found”. No Yosemite “Current Conditions” content and no “Active Alerts” module is visible.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Not satisfied from the screenshot. Instead of Yosemite’s Current Conditions page and its Active Alerts module, the user is on an NPS 404 error page. This indicates the agent did not successfully access/locate the Current Conditions page’s Active Alerts module in the captured view.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Action history references visiting Yosemite pages (conditions/alerts), but the screenshot only shows an NPS 404 “Page not found” error, not the Current Conditions page or an alerts module.

criteria.criterion: Active park-alert count on Yosemite Current Conditions page
criteria.description: From the Current Conditions page, determine the number of active park alerts shown in the official NPS Active Alerts module (not general notices or other page content). Full credit for correctly counting the displayed NPS active alerts. Partial credit if the agent counts alerts but includes non-alert notices or misses an alert due to minor page-structure confusion. If the page/module cannot be accessed despite reasonable attempts, award full credit provided the agent clearly reports the blocker (to avoid double-penalizing the same access issue already captured elsewhere).

While a later 404 occurred, the Current Conditions page itself was accessible earlier; the missing count is therefore not supported as an unavoidable blocker. Score remains 0.

No credit if the agent initiates or attempts a reservation/booking flow or goes materially beyond the stopping condition in a way that risks booking.
